Subject: Re: TeleHealth pilot — cross-border routing + exceptions

Laura / Kimberly / Tessa —

Quick note from infra side on routing exceptions: we will implement a "pilot-only" routing policy that pins TeleHealthCo pilot requests to eu-west by default. Burst fallback to us-east is a hard-coded policy that requires TeleHealth permission. If TeleHealth does not permit offshoring for pilot PII, we can disable burst fallback for the account and set a capacity limit; performance SLAs will change accordingly.

Impact summary:
- If no bursts to us-east: potential 25-40% increased latency at peak and probable queued requests during sustained peaks.
- If bursts allowed with contractual constraint (e.g., only with documented incident/overload), we'll provide log evidence of when routing occurred.

I'll add these notes into the DTIA crosswalk (linking to the routing policy).

Priyom Das
Product Compliance, Redwood Inference
